Filter vsrc_amf
  AMD AMF screen capture
    Inputs:
        none (source filter)
    Outputs:
       #0: default (video)
amf_capture AVOptions:
   monitor_index     <int>        ..FV....... Index of display monitor to capture (from 0 to 8) (default 0)
   framerate         <video_rate> ..FV....... Capture framerate (default "60")
   duplicate_output  <boolean>    ..FV....... Use display output duplication for screen capture (default true)
   capture_mode      <int>        ..FV....... Capture synchronization mode (from 0 to 2) (default keep_framerate)
     keep_framerate  0            ..FV....... Capture component maintains the frame rate
     wait_for_present 1            ..FV....... Capture component waits for flip (present) event
     get_current     2            ..FV....... Returns current visible surface immediately
